title: Andree Valle-Campos
text:
Hi! I’m Andree, an epidemiologist from Peru working in outbreak analytics, serology, and health data science. I bridge epidemiology and quantitative methods to make outbreak response more accessible through teaching and open science.
Most recently, at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM), I developed and organised the short course on outbreak analytics and applied modelling in R, building on the tutorials and how-to guides I wrote for the Epiverse-TRACE project. I’ve trained over 300 epidemiologists across five continents.
I also develop and contribute to R packages that help field epidemiologists analyse line lists, social contact surveys, and serological data to produce real-time estimates and scenarios. I’m currently open to consultancies, roles with national health agencies, and curriculum development in infectious disease dynamics, based in Peru or remotely. If you’re working in this space, I’d love to connect.

title: Bio
text:
Currently

Support training for frontline epidemiologists as a part-time technician at Applied Epi.

Previously

Designed the short course on outbreak analytics and applied modelling in R at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM).
Wrote tutorials and how-to guides on outbreak analytics for the Epiverse-TRACE initiative.
Authored an introduction to geospatial visualization lesson in R for The GRAPH Network.
Published outbreak response research on COVID-19 transmission and seroprevalence with the National Center for Epidemiology (CDC Peru).

title: Bio
text:
Education

MSc in Epidemiological Research (UPCH, 2018), with a thesis project on human mobility and malaria history in the Peruvian Amazon.
BSc in Genetics and Biotechnology (UNMSM, 2015), with a thesis project on antibody responses in severe vivax malaria using protein microarrays.
Trained in scientific computing for genetics and biotech, and in applied statistics for epidemiology.

title: Bio
text:
Skills

Proficient R user, expert tidy data wrangler and ggplot2 visualization enthusiast.
Fluent with bash for automation, ssh for remote computing, and shiny for reactive dashboards.
Experience building statistical workflows with omic, serological, GPS, health service, and outbreak spatio-temporal data.
Further training through these communities: ICTP-SAIFR, CODATA-RDA, RECON, MetaDocencia, The Carpentries.
